answer: Weight each agent by a convex function of unbroken stake-tenure: influence rises steeply only as one key holds a single locked position gap-free across many epochs, a knoll it alone can occupy. Any fault or a missed liveness pulse severs that tenure and resets its clock to zero. A farm spread thin over n clones raises each key's gap rate, so every clone emits only a weak short-tenure signal while one patient honest key compounds past their whole sum. Tenure is elapsed flawless time; it cannot be minted, bought back, or pooled across clones.
